baseline.indexReason: dist/scripts/code-index.js is absent; classification is file-level only and makes no complete symbol/call-graph claim.

classificationRules.cloudZeroMoveMeaning: No current tracked path is safely Cloud-only. Cloud must start from a clean repository; shared or mixed candidates remain in migration-review until split.

highRiskMixedPaths.reason: One application graph imports Community and Enterprise routes; it must become separate product entrypoints.
One generated TypeScript file contains core, user-account, organization and Enterprise management types.
One schema owns Community identifiers and Enterprise organization/command identifiers.
One HTTP schema contains local/core endpoints and Enterprise management endpoints.
One event schema contains core events and Enterprise invalidation events.
The public execution protocol embeds Enterprise Policy and tenant-bound action receipts.
The crate root exports local execution, remote fleet, publication, identity, quota and Enterprise policy modules together.
The SQLite storage crate exports core execution state, server users, fleet placement, Enterprise policy, quota and usage together.
One server composition connects local/core services and Enterprise identity/management.
One generated Rust module contains both public core values and Enterprise organization values.
One generated Rust API contains all current product HTTP types.
Cloud and Enterprise both need PostgreSQL, but ADR-0031 defines no owner for a shared backend adapter outside Community core.
The connector framework is tenant-scoped while the current API exposes it as Enterprise management; Cloud versus Enterprise ownership is unresolved.
Cloud hosted storage and Enterprise customer storage both need this adapter; cross-repository ownership is unresolved.
Hosted operations and private operations both need observability, but no neutral release boundary is defined.
The build script assumes one repository builds all product shapes.
The coverage matrix treats Community/core and Enterprise APIs as one server surface.

migrationConstraints: Do not copy migration-review paths into more than one product repository.
Split mixed schemas and generated files at their source schema before regenerating product outputs.
Preserve Git history for every path moved to Cloud or Enterprise.
Remove migrated product files from Community after the target repository passes its build and tests.
Do not introduce local cross-repository path dependencies.
